method: Evaluate all runtime keys, closing13 and every quarterframe. BVH checks actual evaluated moving cage/bars against every nonhinge native mesh. Exact finite triangle distances against mouth surround, cyan shell and dark mouth at every half-frame. Separately, analytic extrema of every moving native vertex over full angle interval establish continuous bounds and positive separating planes from every nonhinge mesh; fixed/pulsing pieces have unchanged X/Y and native linear scaleZ, whose extrema occur at source keys.

designedHinge.qualification: Unchanged cross-shaft is the intentional rotational hinge inside the connected cage bottom rail. Its designed contact is listed separately, never used to waive a housing collision.

exactFiniteDistanceRecords.method: Exact minimum over finite evaluated triangle pairs: vertex-triangle and all edge-edge distances, with safe box-distance pruning. Native triangle intersection separately tested by BVH.

neutralReservationAndMainSeat: Neutral source geometry/transforms unchanged; verified independently in neutral round01/round02 identity and native assembly audit. No active-main mapping.
facingCoverage: Finite sweep is measured in canonicalS. All standalone facings apply the same rigid common-root yaw to all native surfaces, preserving the measured distances/intersections; all four native key/half-frame view exports are provided. No per-view movement or fitting.
